name: echo-shafts
description: Echo Shafts — a solo Flesh-Warden game. The phone runs the TypeScript sim. Firebase is identity, season time, and a verified leaderboard.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/game --pretty false && tsc -p packages/client --pretty false && tsc -p functions --pretty false
scripts.ios:web: npm run build -w @echo/client && rm -rf ios/EchoShafts/Web && mkdir -p ios/EchoShafts/Web && cp -R packages/client/dist/. ios/EchoShafts/Web/
